run_inference_speed_profiling: run the inference speed profiling script with custom batch size and thread count arguments
run_stream_inference: run multi-threaded CUDA stream-based inference on a PyTorch model with pinned memory transfers
run_profiler_trace: run the PyTorch autograd profiler and export a Chrome trace for inference performance analysis
run_concurrent_inference_threads: run concurrent inference threads that process random frames through a TorchBeast Net model
run_direct_inference: run direct model inference in a loop without CUDA streams or locking mechanisms
